entry.title: Room-temperature superconductivity in a carbonaceous sulfur hydride (cited as canonical CSH retracted-RT-SC anchor)
entry.summary: Reference entry retained as canonical F-RTSC-1 negative anchor: Snider et al. Nature 586:373 (2020), retracted Nature 610:804 (2022). See Hirsch + Marsiglio (2022) for magnetic-susceptibility re-analysis driving retraction.

entry.title: Nonstandard superconductivity or no superconductivity in hydrides under high pressure (Hirsch + Marsiglio retraction-driving critique)
entry.summary: Hirsch + Marsiglio analysis of the Snider 2020 CSH magnetic-susceptibility background-subtraction. This critique drove the 2022 retraction.

entry.title: Conventional superconductivity at 203 K at high pressures in the sulfur hydride system (H3S confirmed reference anchor)
entry.summary: Drozdov et al. Nature 525:73 (2015). Confirmed high-pressure hydride SC at Tc=203 K @ 155 GPa. Reference positive anchor for the hydride superconductor family (distinct from CSH retraction trajectory).
